name: CSC Stat Viewer
author: ethan@example.com
description: A React/Vite statistics viewer application with automatic GitHub updates.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; /usr/local/bin/npm install; /usr/local/bin/npm run build; /usr/local/bin/npx serve -s build -l tcp://${SERVER_IP}:${SERVER_PORT}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /mnt/server
echo "Current directory: $(pwd)"

if [ ! -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo "Cloning from ${GIT_ADDRESS}..."
    if [ -d ".git" ]; then
        git pull
    else
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
    
    if [ ! -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
        echo "Checking out branch ${BRANCH}..."
        git checkout ${BRANCH}
    fi
else
    echo "ERROR: GIT_ADDRESS is not set"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Listing files..."
ls -la

if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
    echo "Installing dependencies..."
    npm install
else
    echo "ERROR: package.json not found!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installation complete!"

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest files on startup when using a GitHub repo.
